raw.field_summary: Boar's Head Provisions Co., Inc., a Jarratt, Va. establishment, is recalling approximately 207,528 pounds of deli meat products that may be adulterated with Listeria monocytogenes. The products bear establishment number "EST. 12612" inside the USDA mark of inspection.

expected.note: establishment number is the identifying code; sell-by ranges are dates
